decisions.reason: As a distant niche line with limited visible commitment and no later website presence, submarine interior lighting is easiest to abandon once management reallocates effort to more central LED businesses.

The medical examination light used existing capabilities, but its weaker fit with the firm’s main building, industrial and maritime focus and its disappearance from later observations make withdrawal more likely than continued justification by 2022.

Industrial explosion-proof luminaires remain close to the firm’s industrial customer base and involved a visibly committed multi-model line, so escalation of commitment still favors persistence despite some uncertainty.

The pendant office luminaire sits squarely in the firm’s established professional lighting offer and supports its stated LED efficiency direction, making continued support more likely than a quick retreat.
The premium pendant luminaire line combines close strategic fit, multiple models and visible launch commitment, which strongly encourages management to continue rather than reverse course.
